background.text:
## 1 Background

Solubility prediction is a standard benchmark task. Previous work has reported that descriptor pruning reduces error by 4.4% [1].

related_work.text:
## 2 Related Work

Prior work on descriptor selection reports gains [1].

gap.text:
## 3 Research Gap

No cited work measures the cost of the descriptor set itself [1], and this paper addresses that.

- We prune the descriptor set (Section 2).
